Creamy Garlic Butter King Prawn Jacket Potato 

Crispy, cheesy, buttery potato topped with juicy Cajun king prawns and a rich creamy garlic sauce 

Cook Book link to my debut cookbook in bio and to this reel.

Potato
• 1 large baking potato
• Olive oil spray
• Sea salt
• Garlic butter
• Salt & pepper
• Mozzarella

Pierce and microwave for 6 mins (less for smaller potatoes). Spray with oil, season with salt, wrap in foil and air fry at 180°C for 55 mins. Unwrap and cook at 200°C for 10 mins until crispy.

Prawns
• 300g king prawns, butterflied
• Garlic pepper
• Sea salt
• Slap Ya Mama Cajun seasoning
• Dried parsley
• Olive oil spray
• 1 knob garlic butter

While the potato cooks, season the prawns and fry until pink. Add garlic butter and baste for 1 min. Remove the prawns, keeping the buttery juices in the pan.

Sauce
• 1 knob garlic butter
• 1 large garlic clove, finely chopped
• 240ml double cream
• 1 tsp chicken stock powder
• ½ tsp garlic pepper
• ¼ tsp garlic granules
• Pinch of salt
• 1 tsp cream cheese
• 2 tbsp mozzarella

Cook the garlic in butter until golden. Add everything except the mozzarella and simmer until slightly thickened. Stir through the mozzarella at the end.

To finish, cut open the potato, add garlic butter, salt, pepper and mozzarella and mash together until melted. Top with the prawns, spoon over the sauce and finish with crispy onions and parsley.

Pat the beef brisket dry and season with salt and pepper. Heat olive oil in a frying pan over medium-high heat. Sear the brisket on all sides until well browned.
Transfer the seared brisket to your slow cooker. Add onion, garlic, tinned tomatoes, tomato paste, red wine, beef stock, and dried Italian herbs.
Cover and cook on low for 8 hours or high for 4 hours, until the brisket is fall-apart tender.
⁠Remove the brisket, shred it using two forks, then return it to the sauce in the slow cooker. Stir well to combine.
Meanwhile, cook your pasta separately according to packet instructions. Drain and add it to the slow cooker. Stir through the brisket sauce until well coated.
Dish it up with a generous sprinkle of grated Parmesan and fresh parsley. Season to taste.

finish with buldak sauce, spicy buldak mayo, and a sprinkle of sugar for that classic korean corn dog combo.
